current_or_proposed_table: person.person_number text nullable; UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT(tenant_id,person_number)
field_recommendation: Keep optional text with ordinary non-null uniqueness, or adopt mandatory generated number after explicit decision
integrity_migration_acceptance: Current constraint permits only one null per tenant. Profile blanks/duplicates; never replace absent identity with invented IDs from email.

current_or_proposed_table: person.first_name/last_name text required; preferred_name/display_name; no effective profile history
field_recommendation: New person_profile_revision: person_id uuid!, effective_from date!, effective_until date?, sequence_no integer!, recorded_at timestamptz!, supersedes_revision_id uuid?, legal_name text!, structured_name jsonb!, preferred_name text?, source_request_id uuid?
integrity_migration_acceptance: Single-name and multilingual structures need country-independent validation. Relax mandatory family-name capture through a migration; preserve historical names and current person projection. Structured names use versioned schema, not arbitrary PII metadata.

current_or_proposed_table: person_sensitive_profile.national_id_type, national_id_token, passport_number_token, tax_identifier_token
field_recommendation: New person_identifier: person_id uuid!, country_code char(2)!, identifier_type_code text!, value_token text!, match_fingerprint text?, issuing_authority text?, issued_on date?, expires_on date?, effective_from date!, effective_until date?, verification_status text!
integrity_migration_acceptance: Multiple IDs per person/country; masked display and audited reveal. Fingerprints use keyed scoped protection, never unsalted hashes of low-entropy IDs. Backfill existing tokens without detokenizing into logs.

current_or_proposed_table: person_sensitive_profile.nationality_country_code, gender, marital_status; person.country_code is ambiguous
field_recommendation: New person_country_profile: person_id uuid!, country_code char(2)!, profile_kind text!, effective_from date!, effective_until date?, schema_version integer!, protected_payload_token text!
integrity_migration_acceptance: Separate nationality, residence and localized payroll attributes; no inferred nationality from person.country_code. Prefer minimal fields per enabled country, with schema validation and strict purpose access.

current_or_proposed_table: person.primary_email/primary_phone; contact_link already has channel_type,value,purpose,is_primary,effective dates and verification fields
field_recommendation: Reuse contact_link/contact_email/contact_phone with registered person ownership; make person.primary_* derived compatibility values
integrity_migration_acceptance: Verify HR lookup/export/privacy rules and owner registry first. Do not create a duplicate contact table or expose home phone through a public work-directory projection.

current_or_proposed_table: address/address_link already support owner, purpose, primary and effective dates
field_recommendation: Reuse shared address/link; add employment-specific context through a typed HR address association only if owner/purpose cannot represent it
integrity_migration_acceptance: Home/mailing/host-work address are different uses. Any proposed association has person_id uuid!, employment_id uuid?, address_link_id uuid!, usage_code text! and range consistency. Protect residential address separately.

current_or_proposed_table: person_sensitive_profile.emergency_contact jsonb
field_recommendation: New person_emergency_contact: person_id uuid!, contact_name_token text!, relationship_code text!, contact_link_id uuid?, priority smallint!, effective_from date!, effective_until date?
integrity_migration_acceptance: Support multiple contacts and priority; approved migration from JSON with review of ambiguous values. Do not force contacts to have user accounts or employee/person identities.

current_or_proposed_table: No dedicated dependant relationship in selected/current DDL scan
field_recommendation: New person_dependant: person_id uuid!, dependant_profile_content_id uuid!, relationship_code text!, effective_from date!, effective_until date?, verification_status text!
integrity_migration_acceptance: Protected profile holds validated name/date-of-birth/identity fields; benefit enrollment references dependant id. Eligibility belongs to policy/coverage, not a permanent is_eligible flag.

current_or_proposed_table: employee.principal_id optional; principal/profile/identity_binding/auth_epoch exist
field_recommendation: Keep login linkage optional; use canonical principal and employment/engagement-scoped access decisions
integrity_migration_acceptance: Do not add password/MFA/provider shadow fields to employee. UI distinguishes principal status from employment and provisioning. Test one relationship ending with another still active.

current_or_proposed_table: external_reference.owner_type_id,owner_id,source_system_code,external_entity_code,external_id
field_recommendation: Reuse for person/employment/engagement/SAP mappings; qualify owner registrations and existing uniqueness rules
integrity_migration_acceptance: Map SAP employment identifiers separately from person and login IDs. Reject conflicting source mappings and quarantine uncertain matches. Do not create a duplicate hr_external_id table.

current_or_proposed_table: Person-sensitive tenant RLS; shared authz roles/groups/scopes/record ACL
field_recommendation: Define scoped operations and field groups: public-work, personal, identity, payroll, banking, case-confidential, commercial-rate
integrity_migration_acceptance: Field authorization applies before serialization/search/count/export and attachment retrieval. Salary and supplier pay-rate access are separately controlled. No new one-boolean HR admin field on person.

current_or_proposed_table: employee duplicates name/contact, department/title/manager/company, hire/termination and employment_type
field_recommendation: Retain employee_number/person_id/principal_id identity; make other fields documented projections or legacy-only inputs during cutover
integrity_migration_acceptance: New commands write person/employment/assignment authority. Do not drop required legacy columns before writer/read migration. Reconcile duplicate values and record provenance.

current_or_proposed_table: v_employee chooses latest employment and assignment independently
field_recommendation: New read contract fields selected_employment_id, selected_assignment_id, as_of_date, source_revision_id; expose current/future/history separately
integrity_migration_acceptance: Filter applicable ranges and select assignment of the same employment/company. Deterministic tie-break; a future active assignment must not become today's placement.

current_or_proposed_table: employment.hire_date,service_date,probation_end_date,termination_date,termination_reason; is_primary and employment_status
field_recommendation: Extend employment: original_hire_date date?, contract_end_date date?, last_working_date date?, notice_date date?, rehire_of_employment_id uuid?, employment_category_code text?
integrity_migration_acceptance: Define service_date meaning before adding another equivalent field. Distinguish fixed-term end, actual termination and last attendance day. Validate chronology, same person for rehire lineage, and preserve unknown historical dates.

current_or_proposed_table: employment is a mutable row; separate employment_status and status
field_recommendation: New employment_revision: employment_id uuid!, effective_from date!, effective_until date?, sequence_no integer!, event_reason_version_id uuid!, source_request_id uuid!, recorded_at timestamptz!, supersedes_revision_id uuid? plus approved changing employment facts
integrity_migration_acceptance: Existing employment remains stable contract identity; revisions own effective terms/status. Migrate without inventing prior history; record imported baseline timestamp. Scoped current/primary exclusions must cover canonical applicable revisions.

current_or_proposed_table: work_assignment has dates, fte, job, manager, company and nullable employment_id
field_recommendation: Require employment_id for new employee writes; add assignment-series/revision identity, sequence_no integer!, event_reason_version_id uuid!, source_request_id uuid?, recorded_at timestamptz!, supersedes_assignment_id uuid?
integrity_migration_acceptance: Rework exclusions for superseded same-day revisions; check assignment within employment and reference company agreement. Existing active-primary exclusion is per employee: explicitly decide primary across versus within concurrent employments.

current_or_proposed_table: work_assignment.fte numeric(5,4), but no standard hours/schedule binding
field_recommendation: Add standard_weekly_hours numeric(8,2)?, employment_class_code text?; new employee_work_schedule_assignment(employee_id uuid!, employment_id uuid!, work_pattern_id uuid!, holiday_calendar_id uuid!, timezone_name text!, effective_from date!, effective_until date?)
integrity_migration_acceptance: FTE and hours are not interchangeable. Validate timezone and schedule policy; calculate total FTE from applicable relationships and guard excessive allocation according to configured policy.

current_or_proposed_table: work_assignment.manager_employee_id and position.reports_to_position_id provide one relation
field_recommendation: New employment_relationship: employment_id uuid!, related_employee_id uuid!, related_employment_id uuid?, relationship_type_code text!, effective_from date!, effective_until date?, source_position_relationship_id uuid?
integrity_migration_acceptance: Types include HR/matrix/second manager with defined cardinality. Prevent self/cyclic reporting where applicable. Do not grant salary access simply because a relation exists.

current_or_proposed_table: position.headcount_capacity,valid_from/valid_to,status,job/company/org/cost fields; tenant/code unique
field_recommendation: Keep stable position; new position_revision with effective range, sequence/version, frozen job/org/grade/hours/capacity values; add vacancy_status text? and hiring_control_code text? only with defined ownership
integrity_migration_acceptance: Headcount/FTE allocation checks must be transaction-safe; preserve historic org/position labels. Avoid storing vacancy as an independently editable number if derived from incumbency.

current_or_proposed_table: workforce_request four request kinds; compensation_change.change_reason_code and employment.termination_reason text
field_recommendation: New hr_event_reason_version: code text!, event_type text!, version_no integer!, permitted_from_statuses text[]!, resulting_status text?, effective_from date!, effective_until date?, rule_version_id uuid?
integrity_migration_acceptance: Use existing governance/version infrastructure if it supplies equivalent semantics. Requests/revisions reference immutable reason versions; workflow derives allowed transitions, not unrestricted status edits.

current_or_proposed_table: workforce_request has schema/hash/idempotency/row_version/materialization evidence but no explicit effective date or business subtype column
field_recommendation: Add effective_date date!, event_reason_version_id uuid!, action_code text!, target_assignment_id uuid?, expected_target_version bigint?
integrity_migration_acceptance: Add only for fields that need indexed routing/validation; keep versioned requested_changes for domain payload. Backfill from validated schemas and quarantine ambiguous requests; existing schema hashes must remain reproducible.

current_or_proposed_table: Multiple employment records but no explicit home/host relation
field_recommendation: New global_assignment: person_id uuid!, home_employment_id uuid!, host_employment_id uuid!, start_date date!, planned_end_date date?, actual_end_date date?, home_treatment_code text!, source_request_id uuid!
integrity_migration_acceptance: Same person on both contracts; distinct contracts; host/home employer validation. Home treatment does not automatically disable home login. Preserve authorized source and country rules.

current_or_proposed_table: onboarding_case.checklist and offboarding_case.checklist JSON; offboarding_case employee only
field_recommendation: Add offboarding_case.employment_id uuid! after backfill; new people_case_task with typed parent FK, task_code text!, assigned_to uuid?, due_at timestamptz?, status text!, completed_at/by?, evidence_content_id uuid?, row_version bigint!
integrity_migration_acceptance: One of onboarding/offboarding parent IDs required if sharing a task table; tenant-scoped FKs. Migrate checklist items with stable codes and evidence. Completing one employment exit must not terminate all contracts.

current_or_proposed_table: shift_assignment employee/date unique; planned_start_at/end_at timestamptz
field_recommendation: Add employment_id uuid!, schedule_assignment_id uuid?, segment_no smallint! if split shifts required, timezone_name text!, source_schedule_version text?
integrity_migration_acceptance: Conditional split-shift change replaces employee/date uniqueness with segment identity and interval checks; preserve unique single-shift behavior until migrated. Overnight work_date uses selected timezone, not only UTC.

current_or_proposed_table: time_punch has punch_at/type/source/device_ref/idempotency and raw/geo payload; attendance_day has calculation_version,trace,source_cutoff_at
field_recommendation: Add attendance_day.policy_version_id uuid!, input_snapshot_id uuid?, employment_id uuid!; punch source_event_id text? only if idempotency key cannot represent device identity
integrity_migration_acceptance: Freeze source/calculation evidence, constrain location payload retention, record approved overrides/recalculations separately. Qualify time-source identity and payroll cutoff.

current_or_proposed_table: No dedicated internal timesheet; external_time_sheet belongs to engagement
field_recommendation: New employee_time_sheet(employment_id uuid!, period_start/end date!, workflow_request_id uuid?, row_version bigint!, status text!); employee_time_entry(sheet_id uuid!, work_date date!, minutes integer!, project_id uuid?, project_task_id uuid?, time_category_code text!, source_punch_group_id uuid?)
integrity_migration_acceptance: No external supplier bill_rate on internal time rows. Avoid duplicate attendance/payroll/costing effects; approved corrections retain original line/version. Proposed punch grouping needs its own typed contract if used.

current_or_proposed_table: leave enrollment opening_balance; ledger quantity_delta, period/date/source/idempotency
field_recommendation: New leave_account(employee_id uuid!, employment_id uuid?, enrollment_id uuid!, account_from/until date!, bookable_from/until date!, unit text!, policy_version_id uuid!, status text!); add ledger.account_id uuid!, entry_kind text!, reverses_entry_id uuid?, calculation_run_id uuid?
integrity_migration_acceptance: Decide employee-wide versus employment scope by policy; enforce units, paired date windows and once-only reversal. Opening balance becomes one imported ledger event, not a second summed source.

current_or_proposed_table: leave_request lacks account reservation identity; balance entries have no explicit reservation table
field_recommendation: New leave_reservation(account_id uuid!, leave_request_id uuid!, quantity numeric(12,4)!, status text!, expires_at timestamptz?); leave_accrual_run(policy_version_id uuid!, period_start/end date!, idempotency_key text!, status text!)
integrity_migration_acceptance: Lock/check account at reservation and approval; pending and approved usage cannot double count. Immutable accrual/correction ledger, bookable window, cancellation and expiry tested.

current_or_proposed_table: pay_component.is_recurring,value_type,taxable_behavior,formula_expression_id; pay_structure_line.default_amount/rate
field_recommendation: New pay_component_version(pay_component_id uuid!, version_no integer!, effective_from/until, frequency_code text?, calculation_kind text!, rounding_scale smallint!, rounding_mode text!, tax_rule_version_id uuid?, formula_expression_version_id uuid?)
integrity_migration_acceptance: Existing recurring/value flags retained as canonical or derived under version contract. Add percentage/base-component relationship where required rather than duplicate is_recurring. Historical calculation pins versions.

current_or_proposed_table: compensation_assignment has base_amount,annualized_amount,employment,pay_group/structure,range; no employee-specific multi-component rows
field_recommendation: New employee_pay_component(assignment_id uuid!, component_version_id uuid!, amount numeric(18,4)?, percentage numeric(9,4)?, quantity numeric(18,4)?, rate numeric(18,8)?, frequency_code text?, currency_code char(3)!)
integrity_migration_acceptance: Validate input combinations by calculation kind; avoid base salary and component double counting. Per-employment/pay-group/range consistency and protected disclosure.

current_or_proposed_table: Additional salary/incentive/retention awards lack a dedicated input record
field_recommendation: New employee_pay_award(employment_id uuid!, component_version_id uuid!, award_kind text!, pay_date date!, amount numeric(18,4)!, currency_code char(3)!, vesting_date date?, recovery_terms_content_id uuid?, approved_request_id uuid!); payroll_input_consumption(award_id uuid!, result_line_id uuid!, amount numeric(18,4)!)
integrity_migration_acceptance: Approval, vesting and actual payment separate; consumption/adjustment lineage prevents duplicate pay. Recurring schedule supported by child occurrences rather than copying mutable award totals.

current_or_proposed_table: bank_account/link support protected ownership/purpose/company/range; no explicit payroll split instruction
field_recommendation: New employee_payment_instruction(employment_id uuid!, effective_from/until, payment_method_code text!, currency_code char(3)!, approved_request_id uuid!, version_no integer!); distribution(instruction_id uuid!, bank_account_link_id uuid!, priority smallint!, percent numeric(7,4)?, fixed_amount numeric(18,4)?, is_remainder boolean!)
integrity_migration_acceptance: Enforce allowed split mode, one remainder and allocation totals under transaction lock; verify employee owner registry. Existing account tokenization retained, no raw bank fields in employment.

current_or_proposed_table: statutory enrollment employee_id,scheme,member_number text,dates; tax declarations include employment/country/year/version
field_recommendation: Add enrollment.employment_id uuid? where scheme belongs to employer; member_number_token text? and masked suffix; scheme/policy version uuid! on accepted calculations
integrity_migration_acceptance: Member number may be sensitive: classify before migration. Preserve multi-employment country coverage; do not apply one scheme/member number globally to all contracts.

current_or_proposed_table: payroll_run_employee unique(run,employee), assignment FK; result employee/currency/totals; line formula version and trace already exist
field_recommendation: Add explicit employment_id uuid! to run eligibility/result where required; new payroll_input_snapshot(run_id uuid!, employment_id uuid!, source_kind text!, source_id uuid!, source_version text!, payload_hash char(64)!, protected_content_id uuid?); run.rule_package_version_id uuid!, input_cutoff_at timestamptz!
integrity_migration_acceptance: Define per-person versus per-employment calculation/aggregation before key migration. Preserve existing formula trace; add cross-source provenance, no duplicate trace store. Golden results for concurrent employment and corrections.

current_or_proposed_table: payroll_run.reversal_of_run_id, posted_journal_entry_id; result net/amount checks and non-negative line amounts
field_recommendation: Add payroll_adjustment(original_result_id uuid!, replacement_result_id uuid?, adjustment_kind text!, reason_code text!, source_request_id uuid!); payment handoff references use finance canonical records
integrity_migration_acceptance: Specify signed delta versus replacement-result representation before relaxing amount checks. Reconcile prior/new liability, prevent duplicate posting, and keep payslip issuance separate from payment.

current_or_proposed_table: document.employee_expense_claim / employee_expense_line
field_recommendation: Header: employment_id uuid!, company_code_id uuid!, currency_code char(3)!, workflow_request_id uuid?, approved_payable_ref uuid?. Line: claim_id uuid!, expense_date date!, expense_type_code text!, amount numeric(18,4)!, tax_amount numeric(18,4)?, receipt_content_id uuid?, fx_rate_snapshot_id uuid?, project_id uuid?
integrity_migration_acceptance: Typed finance payable adapter; receipts protected; duplicate claims flagged; currency/FX and tax evidence frozen. Existing external expense tables remain unchanged in purpose.

current_or_proposed_table: document.employee_travel_request / travel_itinerary
field_recommendation: employment_id uuid!, purpose text!, start_at/end_at timestamptz!, budget_amount numeric(18,4)!, currency_code char(3)!, policy_version_id uuid!, approved_request_id uuid?; itinerary request_id uuid!, destination_country char(2)!, arrival/departure timestamptz!
integrity_migration_acceptance: Approval and subsequent claims linked; reasonable date/budget controls. No travel booking integration assumed unless separately selected.

current_or_proposed_table: document.employee_advance / advance_settlement
field_recommendation: employment_id uuid!, requested_amount numeric(18,4)!, approved_amount numeric(18,4)?, currency_code char(3)!, due_date date?, disbursement_ref uuid?; settlement advance_id uuid!, source_type text!, source_id uuid!, amount numeric(18,4)!, reversal_of_id uuid?
integrity_migration_acceptance: Reference governed finance source registry or typed source FKs; outstanding balance derived from disbursement and settlement ledger, never independently editable.

current_or_proposed_table: master.benefit_plan_version; document.benefit_enrollment / benefit_claim / benefit_consumption
field_recommendation: Plan code text!, version integer!, coverage_from/until date!, eligibility_rule_version_id uuid!, cap_amount numeric(18,4)?, currency char(3)?. Enrollment employment_id uuid!, plan_version_id uuid!, dependant_id uuid?, effective range. Claim enrollment_id uuid!, amount numeric(18,4)!, evidence_content_id uuid?
integrity_migration_acceptance: Eligible dependant links, policy-specific caps, concurrent consumption guard, approved payment/payroll handoff. Tax treatment is country configuration, not inferred.

current_or_proposed_table: document.employee_settlement / employee_settlement_line / payroll_payment_hold
field_recommendation: Settlement employment_id uuid!, offboarding_case_id uuid!, as_of_date date!, rule_version_id uuid!, currency char(3)!, approved_at/by?. Lines component_code text!, source_kind/id!, amount numeric(18,4)!. Hold employment_id uuid!, reason_code text!, amount numeric(18,4)?, effective_from date!, released_at/by?
integrity_migration_acceptance: Salary payment hold is not an arbitrary payroll deduction. Final leave/advance/bonus effects reconcile; releases/reversals have actor/reason evidence.

current_or_proposed_table: document.exit_interview / exit_interview_answer; extend hr_case with participant/event children
field_recommendation: Interview offboarding_case_id uuid!, template_version_id uuid!, conducted_at timestamptz?, response_content_id uuid?. Case participant case_id uuid!, principal_id uuid!, participant_role text!, access_until timestamptz?; event case_id uuid!, event_type text!, occurred_at timestamptz!, evidence_content_id uuid?
integrity_migration_acceptance: Employee feedback and investigations require separate ACLs; no existence/count leakage. Resolve appeal/retention policy through governed configuration.

current_or_proposed_table: hiring_requisition, internal_candidate, job_application, interview_evaluation, employment_offer
field_recommendation: Requisition position_id/company_id uuid!, vacancies numeric!, approval_ref uuid?. Candidate protected_profile_content_id uuid!, person_id uuid?. Application candidate_id/requisition_id uuid!, stage_code text!. Offer application_id uuid!, proposed_start_date date!, employment_type_code text!, terms_content_id uuid!, accepted_at timestamptz?
integrity_migration_acceptance: Tables belong to Neon document/master by lifecycle ownership agreed in design. Internal hiring is separate from supplier submission. Accepted offer creates one workforce request with protected identity matching.

current_or_proposed_table: master.skill / skill_level / job_skill_requirement; document.person_skill_assessment
field_recommendation: Skill code text!, name text!, taxonomy_version text!. Assessment person_id uuid!, skill_id uuid!, level_id uuid!, assessed_at timestamptz!, assessor_id uuid!, evidence_content_id uuid?, expires_on date?
integrity_migration_acceptance: Evidence-backed proficiency; shared skill dictionary for both roles, independent disclosure and eligibility. Never overwrite assessed skill with an unreviewed inferred value.

current_or_proposed_table: learning_course_version, training_event, training_enrollment, training_result, training_feedback
field_recommendation: Course version/code!, event course_version_id uuid!, start/end timestamptz!, capacity integer?. Enrollment event_id/person_id uuid!. Result enrollment_id uuid!, outcome text!, score numeric?, certificate_id uuid?. Feedback template_version_id uuid!, response_content_id uuid!
integrity_migration_acceptance: Event enrollment uniqueness/capacity, immutable completion evidence, certification reuse. Supplier-visible training evidence must be explicitly scoped.

current_or_proposed_table: appraisal_cycle, appraisal, appraisal_goal, appraisal_review, calibration_decision
field_recommendation: Cycle template_version_id uuid!, period range!. Appraisal employment_id uuid!, cycle_id uuid!. Goal weight numeric(7,4)!, target text!. Review reviewer_principal_id uuid!, reviewer_role text!, rating numeric?, evidence_content_id uuid?. Calibration original/final_rating numeric?, reason text!
integrity_migration_acceptance: Weight rules, reviewer conflicts, locked review versions, acknowledgment; no direct salary write from rating.

current_or_proposed_table: compensation_planning_cycle / planning_award; succession_plan / succession_nomination / development_action
field_recommendation: Cycle budget/currency and rule_version_id!. Award employment_id uuid!, proposed_amount numeric(18,4)!, approved_amount numeric(18,4)?. Succession position_id uuid!, nominee_employee_id uuid!, readiness_code text!, reviewed_at timestamptz!. Action person_id uuid!, skill_id uuid?, due_date date?
integrity_migration_acceptance: Separate planner/approver roles, confidential successor visibility, budget guards; approved award becomes compensation request. These extend the initial screenshot toward the talent benchmark.

current_or_proposed_table: external_worker.person_id,worker_number,default_classification,status
field_recommendation: Retain reusable role identity. External Worker 360 derives suppliers and engagement status from selected/active engagements
integrity_migration_acceptance: Do not add supplier_id/company_id/salary to external_worker master: a person can work through multiple relationships. A new stable person is not required when an employee gains an external role.

current_or_proposed_table: workforce_requisition has company/legal entity,job/position/org/site,headcount,dates,target rate and workflow
field_recommendation: Add hiring_reason_code text?, required_by date?, budget_evidence_id uuid?, evaluation_template_version_id uuid?; new requisition_skill_requirement(requisition_id uuid!, skill_id uuid!, minimum_level_id uuid?, mandatory boolean!)
integrity_migration_acceptance: Existing purchase_requisition_id is the procurement link. Derive remaining headcount from accepted fills; do not add an independently editable filled_count.

current_or_proposed_table: requisition_supplier unique(requisition,supplier), distribution_snapshot,response_due_at
field_recommendation: New supplier_distribution_wave(requisition_id uuid!, wave_no integer!, release_at timestamptz!, rule_version_id uuid?); distribution_attempt(existing_distribution_id uuid!, wave_id uuid!, delivered_at timestamptz?, response_due_at timestamptz?, idempotency_key text!)
integrity_migration_acceptance: Keep stable supplier distribution and append wave/attempt evidence; avoid breaking source FKs by duplicating the same supplier record. Supplier-isolated access and replay-safe delivery.

current_or_proposed_table: external_candidate_submission has supplier/requisition,protected profile/hash,person_id?,rate,availability,consent_evidence_id; evaluation has kind/outcome/score/evidence
field_recommendation: Add evaluation.template_version_id uuid?, interview_event_id uuid? when process requires scheduling; new candidate_match_decision(submission_id uuid!, matched_person_id uuid?, decision text!, reviewed_by uuid!, evidence_hash char(64)!)
integrity_migration_acceptance: Existing hash uniqueness is supplier/requisition scoped, not a global person deduplication guarantee. Matching is reviewed; protect candidate data before selection.

current_or_proposed_table: contingent_work_order current_revision_no; revision has dates/classification/rate_id,bill_rate,pay_rate,NTE,terms hash,approval/supplier acceptance
field_recommendation: Add rate_policy_version_id uuid?, extension_of_revision_id uuid?, decision_reason_code text? where prior_revision_id/change_reason cannot express the policy; preserve existing immutable terms
integrity_migration_acceptance: Do not duplicate effective rate fields on another editable authority. Worker supplier pay_rate is confidential commercial information, not buyer payroll salary. Test new revision effective-date boundaries and supplier acceptance.

current_or_proposed_table: worker_engagement references work-order/SOW header; repeated bill_rate/NTE; no direct commercial revision FK
field_recommendation: Add contingent_work_order_revision_id uuid? and statement_of_work_revision_id uuid?; exactly one matching parent type; revisions must be approved/accepted/effective for activation
integrity_migration_acceptance: Pin accepted terms for each engagement amendment/time claim. Treat copied bill_rate/NTE as validated snapshots or derive them; define amendment effect on existing claims explicitly. Backfill from evidence, not blindly current_revision_no.

current_or_proposed_table: SOW revision has allow_workers/time/expense,auto_invoice,terms/budget; item has type,quantity,unit_price,due date and acceptance
field_recommendation: Extend item acceptance via document.sow_item_acceptance(item_id uuid!, accepted_quantity numeric(18,4)!, accepted_amount numeric(18,4)!, accepted_at/by!, evidence_content_id uuid?, reverses_acceptance_id uuid?) if partial/repeated acceptance cannot be represented by canonical service-sheet allocation
integrity_migration_acceptance: Reuse existing service_sheet_source_allocation as authority where sufficient; do not introduce a second acceptance ledger. Deliverable-only SOW remains valid without worker records.

current_or_proposed_table: rate card/rate have effective dates,regular/min/max rates,OT/doubletime multipliers,supplier markup
field_recommendation: Add rate.version_no integer!, calculation_basis_code text!, rounding_scale smallint!, rounding_mode text!, policy_version_id uuid? or freeze equivalent existing published rate versions
integrity_migration_acceptance: No duplicate overtime_multiplier. Version non-regular rate categories and overrides as child rules only when required; reference applied rule/version from claim rate_snapshot. Reject ambiguous overlapping rate precedence.

current_or_proposed_table: engagement.maximum_tenure_days,start/end,readiness_evidence/hash; no cross-engagement tenure contract found
field_recommendation: New worker_tenure_policy_version(scope/company/classification!, count_method text!, maximum_days integer!, break_reset_days integer?, effective dates!, version_no integer!); tenure_evaluation(person_id uuid!, policy_version_id uuid!, evaluated_as_of date!, accumulated_days integer!, outcome text!, source_set_hash char(64)!)
integrity_migration_acceptance: Count the intended person/company/legal scope across suppliers/contracts, avoid double-counting overlaps, document breaks and exceptions. Thresholds are configured policy, not legal advice from this report.

current_or_proposed_table: engagement.readiness_evidence JSON plus hash and activated_at/by; activation check requires eligible=true
field_recommendation: Add readiness_evaluation_id uuid? referencing immutable decision/evaluation evidence; policy_version_id and input snapshot references on evaluation
integrity_migration_acceptance: Existing activation gate is useful. Bind safe result to exact terms/compliance/tenure versions and recheck stale evidence at activation/extension; a JSON boolean is not the whole evaluation engine.

current_or_proposed_table: worker_operational_placement has company/date range,allocation_percent,is_primary; existing exclusion/activation guard
field_recommendation: Retain; strengthen composite company-bound references where suitable; add source_request_id uuid?, placement_revision_no integer? only if needed for history
integrity_migration_acceptance: Current command already enforces engagement company/date scope. Review cost center/site/org alignment and aggregate allocation across concurrent placements with locked temporal checks; row <=100 does not enforce sum <=100.

current_or_proposed_table: worker_compliance_item unique(engagement,requirement_code,requirement_version); decided rows immutable; decision,validity,evidence/fingerprints
field_recommendation: New compliance_evidence_revision(requirement_item_id uuid!, revision_no integer!, supersedes_revision_id uuid?, evidence_content_id uuid!, valid_from/until date?, decision text!, decided_at/by!, decision_fingerprint char(64)!); or equivalent governed evidence child
integrity_migration_acceptance: Renewal of evidence under the same requirement version must append a new decision rather than mutating a decided row or inventing a policy version. Derive expired state as of date; do not rewrite immutable decisions.

current_or_proposed_table: compliance decision CHECK uses pending iff all decision fields null
field_recommendation: Add explicit all-or-none decision audit/fingerprint check, conditional on non-pending
integrity_migration_acceptance: As written, non-pending can satisfy the CHECK with only some decision fields populated; guard protects immutability after decision but does not alone prove complete decision evidence. Profile existing rows before validating tighter check.

current_or_proposed_table: engagement access_status command-owned; IAM intent carries person/sourceRef/desiredVersion/hash
field_recommendation: Reuse existing identity intent/delivery. Add source-scoped access validity/reconciliation evidence only where existing trustiam/application authority cannot express it
integrity_migration_acceptance: Never add a second principal shadow table. Access expiry is the minimum applicable authorized grant window, with policy for other relationships; stale/replayed delivery cannot restore revoked access.

current_or_proposed_table: engagement_onboarding_case.checklist JSON; no dedicated external exit case in inspected table inventory
field_recommendation: New engagement_exit_case(engagement_id uuid!, planned_end_date date!, termination_reason_code text!, workflow_request_id uuid?, completed_at/by?); typed engagement_case_task(parent_case_id uuid!, task_code text!, owner_principal_id uuid?, due_at timestamptz?, evidence_content_id uuid?, status text!)
integrity_migration_acceptance: Reuse checklist task machinery but enforce engagement parent FK and privacy. Access removal, asset return and financial close are independently visible outcomes.

current_or_proposed_table: external_time_entry has work_date,hours,rate,currency,generated amount,cost/project/task/SOW item,rate_snapshot/hash
field_recommendation: Add source_commercial_revision_id through typed work-order/SOW revision references; source_rate_version_id uuid?; unit/quantity extension only for genuinely non-hour claims
integrity_migration_acceptance: Existing table is hours-based. Do not price day/week work by silently relabelling hours; support typed quantity/unit claim lines or retain non-hour acceptance in SOW items. Preserve source-rate snapshot on approved revisions.

current_or_proposed_table: external_expense_item has amount,tax_amount,currency,receipt and merchant
field_recommendation: Add policy_version_id uuid?, reimbursement_basis_code text?, original_amount/currency and fx_rate_snapshot_id where claim and contract currencies differ
integrity_migration_acceptance: Contract allows/limits expense types and dates. Distinguish supplier billable expense from worker reimbursement without assigning buyer payroll eligibility.

current_or_proposed_table: service_sheet_source_allocation records accepted qty/amount,source snapshot/hash,reversal/idempotency
field_recommendation: Reuse canonical allocation; extend source-line granularity only if acceptance of individual time/expense lines requires it
integrity_migration_acceptance: Prove cumulative acceptance and reversals cannot exceed approved source or contract budget under concurrency. Do not reuse deprecated external_service_entry or external_workforce_invoice_allocation for new writes.

current_or_proposed_table: work order/SOW/engagement each have NTE-related values; purchase commitment and invoice infrastructure exist
field_recommendation: New contract_budget_reservation/commercial_consumption evidence only if existing commitment/acceptance ledger cannot express reserved,accepted,invoiced/reversed amounts
integrity_migration_acceptance: Keep one reconciled budget authority with currency/revision/FX/source IDs, not three independent spent_amount fields. Allocate shared SOW cap across workers and deliverables.

current_or_proposed_table: Person can hold employee and external_worker; no dedicated conversion record found
field_recommendation: New workforce_conversion_request(person_id uuid!, source_engagement_id uuid!, target_workforce_request_id uuid!, conversion_date date!, supplier_release_evidence_id uuid?, conversion_fee_reference uuid?, decision text!)
integrity_migration_acceptance: Same person retained; conversion does not rewrite historical external claims as payroll. Supplier release/fee applies only when configured contractual terms require it.

current_or_proposed_table: requisition/submission/evaluation/time/compliance contain reporting sources
field_recommendation: New supplier_workforce_metric_snapshot(supplier_id uuid!, company_code_id uuid!, period_start/end date!, metric_code text!, numerator/denominator numeric?, value numeric?, definition_version text!, source_hash char(64)!) or equivalent reporting projection
integrity_migration_acceptance: Define fill time, rejection, rate variance, compliance and invoice exceptions; immutable metric definitions and authorized drilldown. Exclude sensitive candidate facts from broadly shared scorecards.
